comment: The feedback she gives is a whole lot of nothing. Also a bit rude at times. The class was easy though.
good professor and very accessible. She will give more feedback if you ask actively, but if not you won't get a lot
Nice enough - a little condescending at times though. Not clear with feedback.

Dr. Ireland was happy to meet to discuss and give feedback on my papers, and she offered several chances to revise them. She was also willing to give extensions, as long she was notified in advance. The papers included two research papers, a personal essay and a restaurant review (and we got to eat at a restaurant, paid for by the university!).

Dr Ireland is a great teacher who is clearly passionate about the subject she teaches. Our class had 3 papers which made up the majority of the course grade as well as weekly reading questions. The papers were graded a little harsh, but the feedback was very helpful and she is always willing to help.

Highly recommend this class for FYS. Very interesting topic, and she does a very good job engaging the class. Readings are generally short (10-15 pages per class). Somewhat easy grader on papers as well.

Whatever thoughts you have about the course being named "dining out" are probably true. Although we never actually went out as a class into the city of Richmond to eat, the class was light. Homework was 1-2 readings (guy fieri food reviews...) not bad at all. Only 3 essays total including the final paper. Way easier workload than other FYS classes.
